crossRefs.note: For Yahweh’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down…
“I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled…
I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”

people.name: Etam
people.line: Cliff where Samson hid after defeating the Philistines

translations.web: He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.
translations.bsb: And he struck them ruthlessly with a great slaughter, and then went down and stayed in the cave at the rock of Etam.
translations.kjv: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.
translations.asv: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the cleft of the rock of Etam.
